content.value:
. Determine the overall heat transfer coefficient for a FPC system inclined at $4 5 ^ { \circ }$ to the 19   
horizontal and facing due south for the following parameters:   
• The average ambient air temperature for the day is $2 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$   
• The observed glass and absorber plate temperature are $5 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and $7 0 ^ { \circ } C ,$ respectively   
• The system is provided with 5 cm thick insulation (glass wool) at the bottom and the   
thermal conductivity of insulation is 0.03 W Im. °C   
• The air space between the absorber plate and the glass cover has an optimum thickness   
of75 cm   
• The emissivity or the glass and the plate are 0.8 and 0.95, respectively.
